fairness.rule: Equivalent supported wording can be correct. Literal atom mismatch alone is not proof of bad reasoning. Do not silently alter gold after seeing output.

fairness.rule: Positive support may use selective reading; absence requires sufficiently inspected scope. Honest uncertainty is a limitation, not fabricated completion. Do not demand fast guessed absence.
New upload invalidates current package result. Borrower acknowledges saved files; investigator revalidates observations and prior findings.
Never label a scripted/offline pass or missing semantic review as live model accuracy.

Measure from accepted work; record queue, first useful reply, result publication and final reply separately. Count timeout/cancel/failure/unknown timing, retain slow attempts. Exclude human thinking between separate journey requests.

experimentOrder: Freeze completed streaming plus incremental runtime; no partial shared-checkout candidate.
Validate native schema, incremental saved outcomes, stale-source and conflicting-new-evidence negatives offline.
Run bounded development baseline at medium/24k: D01 gradual, D02 supersession, D03 amendment; D07 scans and D08 authority after core correctness.
Compare lower reasoning only as separately pinned development variant if incremental runtime still misses latency targets; no live-pilot setting changes implied.
Choose only a candidate passing reviewed quality and latency; repeat small set for variability within existing spend limits.
Freeze winner, then run unseen holdouts once; if holdout failures guide fixes, retire them from unseen validation.
